# tenant commands

Every `tenant` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `tenant:list`

List all registered tenants

```bash
bin/semitexa tenant:list
```

## `tenant:run`

Execute a command in a specific tenant context

```bash
bin/semitexa tenant:run <tenant> <cmd>
```
